name: Smith Machine Curl
steps: Face the bar at thigh height and take a shoulder-width underhand grip.
Release the hooks and stand tall with your arms extended and the bar close to your thighs.
Bend your elbows and let them travel back as the bar rises close to your torso along the rails.
Lower the bar slowly back down to full arm extension under strict control.
tips: Let your elbows drift naturally back along the fixed vertical track rather than fighting the bar path.
Avoid leaning backward or using knee bounce to heave the bar upward.
